Workflow.Name: DealOS | Inspection result
Workflow.Description: Inspection set to Passed → verification record (independent inspection, Confirmed) + Inspection milestone Completed with the report → both told. Failed → deal On Hold + Deal Manager task (renegotiate or cancel with refund) → both told.
